hints.title: Bitwise Column Independence Principle
hints.text: Total difference between all pairs decomposes into independent bit column contributions across each of the thirty-two binary positions.

hints.title: Pairwise Cross Product Invariant
hints.text: For any bit position, if k numbers have bit one and n minus k numbers have bit zero, exactly k times (n minus k) pairs differ at that position.

hints.title: Bit Column Counting Procedure
hints.text: Initialize total sum to zero. Loop through all bit positions from 0 to 31. For each position, count how many numbers have that bit set to one. Multiply this count by n minus count, and add the product to total sum. Return total sum.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs takes O(N^2) quadratic time, which fails on arrays of up to 10,000 integers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting bit columns processes the array in 32 * N operations, achieving O(N) runtime and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize bit column independence and explain the combinatorial formula k * (n - k).
